name: search_foods
description: Search the app's food catalogue. Returns food_id, name, nutrients per 100 g and Ayurvedic effect (vata/pitta/kapha from -2 pacifies to +2 aggravates). Foods with the person's allergens are left out by default.

query.description: Food name or description, in the person's language or English.

max_per_100g.description: Nutrient key (protein, energy, sodium, totalSugar, totalFat, carbs) to a maximum per 100 g.

name: get_day
description: What is logged for a day: meals, foods with grams, totals, and warnings against the person's constraints.

name: log_food
description: Propose adding foods to a meal. Nothing is written: the app shows a card with the app's own check, and the person confirms. Use food_id values from search_foods.

meal.description: The meal name from get_profile, or breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack.

name: remove_logged_food
description: Propose removing a logged food from a meal; the person confirms.

name: get_profile
description: The person's age, sex, height, weight, Ayurvedic constitution, allergens, dietary constraints and meal names. No name or photo.

name: set_dietary_constraints
description: Propose saving constraints the person stated (their own, from a doctor, a prescription or a lab report). The app shows them as an editable list and stores only what the person confirms. Never invent a limit.

nutrient.description: protein, energy, carbs, totalSugar, totalFat, saturatedFat, fiber, sodium, potassium, phosphorus, calcium, iron, cholesterol, vitaminK

food.description: For exclude_food / prefer_food: one food word, e.g. tomato.

name: create_recipe
description: Propose creating a recipe with the app's own generator; it appears in the app's Generate tab.

name: create_food
description: Propose creating a food that is not in the catalogue; it appears in the app's Generate tab.

name: create_meal_plan
description: Propose a meal plan for 1 to 7 days, made by the app's generator with the stored constraints and allergies, then checked by the app.

notes.description: Wishes for the plan, e.g. 'more protein at breakfast'.

name: set_constitution
description: Propose saving the constitution from the person's answers to the app's 12 questions, in order, one of vata/pitta/kapha each (the dosha of the option the person chose). Only after all 12 were asked and answered.

name: find_practice
description: Find the app's guided practices (breathing, meditation, relaxation) by goal or name.

name: find_pose
description: Find yoga poses in the app by name, Sanskrit name or purpose.
